title: L1A Question
description: One exam-bank item. Non-negotiable per CLAUDE.md: exactly four options, a rationale on every one of them including the correct one, and a primary concept ID. Scenario items must be clinically realistic. See docs/master-plan.md 7.

id.description: Question ID: the primary concept ID plus -Qnnn, e.g. EMT-02-03-04-Q001. Keeps the bank self-indexing - the concept a question belongs to is readable from its id alone.

concept_id.description: Primary concept this question tests. A miss here is what feeds the Focus List, so it must be the concept actually being assessed, not merely mentioned.

secondary_concepts.description: Other concept IDs the item draws on - typically the assessment or pharmacology concept a scenario also exercises. Weighted lower than the primary in weak-spot detection.

style.description: Matches the keys of concept.question_targets so the bank can be audited against the per-concept budget.

stem.description: The question. Scenario items open with the call, e.g. what you find on arrival, then ask one thing. Avoid absolutes unless the absolute is the point.

options.description: Exactly four. Order is the display order; correct_index points into this array. Distractors should come from the concept's misconceptions[] wherever possible - that is what makes a wrong answer instructive instead of filler.

rationale.description: Required on all four. For the correct option say why it is right; for each wrong one say why it is wrong, not merely that it is. This is the whole teaching value of the bank.

correct_index.description: Zero-based index into options[]. Exactly one correct answer; where the real exam would ask for the best answer, the stem says so and the rationales explain why the runners-up lose.

difficulty.description: 1 = foundational, 3 = typical exam level, 5 = hardest application. Drives adaptive simulation selection; should sit near the parent concept's difficulty.

domain.description: Exam domain for score-report breakdown and domain-weighted selection. Normally inherited from the primary concept; set it explicitly when a scenario is scored under a different domain than the concept's home. EMT-only enum, extended when Fire and Paramedic begin.

media.description: Media id for image-based items - an ECG strip, equipment photo, or wound image. Must resolve to an entry in the primary concept's media[] array. Required in practice for style 'image'.

verify.description: True = a fact, dose or rationale in this item is unconfirmed. Per CLAUDE.md, flag rather than guess. A flagged question is never served in a module exam or full simulation, for the same reason a flagged concept is not: module exams gate progression.

verify_notes.description: What needs checking. Expected whenever verify is true.

allOf.description: If it is flagged for verification, say what needs verifying.
An image-style item needs an image.
